title: Desktop Intent Authority Extraction and Monolith Elimination — Structural Audit
summary: Remote-main inspection of rig_relay/desktop/_intents/ reveals 8 files (~580 KB total) that are either identical monolith copies with zero external importers (_bundle, _spawn, _validation, _chat, _queue, _storage), partially dead (_refinement), or the canonical live dispatcher (_refresh) with 3 missing function definitions and 3 missing import references. The file-splitting operation lost _classify_intent, _execute_allowed_intent, and PHASE_1_ENABLED from the codebase, making the live dispatch path non-functional.

_bundle.py.note: Identical monolith copy. Contains execute_desktop_intent and 32 helper functions. No external imports. Safe to delete.

_spawn.py.note: Identical monolith copy. No external imports. Safe to delete.

_validation.py.note: Identical monolith copy. No external imports. Safe to delete.

_chat.py.note: Identical monolith copy. No external imports. Safe to delete.

_queue.py.note: Identical monolith copy. No external imports. Safe to delete.

_storage.py.note: Identical monolith copy. No external imports. Safe to delete.

_refinement.py.note: Entire execute_desktop_intent and 32 helpers are dead copies. Only _execute_site_editor_save is used externally. The site editor save function is desktop-domain logic that performs validation + atomic write + render.

critical_defects: PHASE_1_ENABLED undefined — lost during file split
ALLOWED_INTENTS referenced but not imported (defined in intents.py)
PROTECTED_INTENTS referenced but not imported (defined in intents.py)
_build_result referenced but not imported (defined in intents.py)
_refresh.py.note: The canonical live dispatcher. Contains execute_desktop_intent with gateway pre-pass, _handle_phase_1_protected_intent, and all domain handler functions (identity, telemetry, provider, worktree, fleet, etc.). Missing 3 definitions and 3 imports make it non-functional.

_shared.py.note: Thin re-export: from _refresh import execute_desktop_intent. Correctly thin.

intents.py.note: Public API surface. Defines ALLOWED_INTENTS, PROTECTED_INTENTS, _build_result, validate_intent_request. Re-exports execute_desktop_intent from _shared. Imports _execute_site_editor_save from _refinement (only live link to _refinement).

responsibility_assessment.application_service_worthy_domain_behavi: _refresh.py contains ~30 domain handler functions that should eventually be extracted to typed application services (identity, telemetry consent, provider onboarding, worktree management, fleet orchestration, council, site editor)
responsibility_assessment.governance_evidence_state_transition_log: _refresh.py _handle_phase_1_protected_intent (authorization gate), validate_protected_intent_authorization (receipt validation), capability gate checks
responsibility_assessment.duplicated_shared_execution_shell: The monolithic execute_desktop_intent dispatch pattern is duplicated in 8 files (6 dead, 1 partially dead, 1 live). Progress emission, lifecycle event construction, and intent classification are copy-pasted.
responsibility_assessment.dead_or_superseded_code: _bundle.py, _spawn.py, _validation.py, _chat.py, _queue.py, _storage.py — all dead. _refinement.py dispatcher is dead (only _execute_site_editor_save is live).
responsibility_assessment.compatibility_surface: intents.py ALLOWED_INTENTS, PROTECTED_INTENTS, _build_result — must remain available. _refinement._execute_site_editor_save — must remain callable.

missing_definitions_from_git_history._classify_intent: Function that classifies intent names as 'phase1_protected', 'protected', 'allowed', or 'unsupported' based on membership in PHASE_1_ENABLED, PROTECTED_INTENTS, and ALLOWED_INTENTS dicts.
missing_definitions_from_git_history._execute_allowed_intent: Lambda-based dispatch table mapping intent names to handler functions. ~30 handlers including identity, telemetry, provider, worktree, fleet, council, site editor, validation, storage, queue, spawn, refinement.
missing_definitions_from_git_history.PHASE_1_ENABLED: Dict mapping 'checkpoint.commit' and 'lease_cleanup.archive' to their intent names — these are Phase 1 receipt-gated intents.

methodology: Read remote-main source via local checkout confirmed at remote HEAD (964d6ef). Searched all Python imports with ripgrep. Verified external importers for each file. Cross-referenced against git history at 6d836d007 to recover lost definitions. Used AST analysis to enumerate undefined symbols in execute_desktop_intent.
